questions.q: Real wage unemployment is caused by:
options: Real wages being held above the market-clearing level
questions.why: Labour supplied exceeds labour demanded at that wage.

questions.q: The natural rate of unemployment is made up of:
questions.why: It's what remains when there's no cyclical unemployment.

questions.q: Which would lower the natural rate of unemployment?
options: Higher government spending for a year
A rise in the money supply
A fall in the exchange rate
questions.why: It needs a change on the supply side.

questions.q: Output lost through unemployment can't be regained later.
questions.why: The chance to produce that output has gone.

questions.q: How does long-term unemployment harm the economy's long-run growth?
options: Workers lose skills, so human capital falls

questions.q: Explain how high unemployment can affect the government's budget.

ideas.label: Tax revenue falls, so borrowing rises

questions.model: Spending on benefits rises, and tax revenue falls because fewer people earn and spend. So the budget deficit widens.
questions.why: Both sides of the budget get worse.

tests.answer: Benefit spending rises and tax revenue falls.
